_: Material 3 baseline LIGHT scheme, extracted 2026-09-23 from the material3 artifact the build resolves (material3-android 1.4.0 in the Gradle cache), by disassembling ColorLightTokens and PaletteTokens with javap -- the same way material3-dark.json was made. The app calls lightColorScheme() with no arguments when dynamic colour is off, so these are the colours of the app in light mode then.
_why: The page's light theme (docs/PLAN_WEB_PARITY.md W7). The dark page uses the owner's sampled dynamic scheme (app-colours.json); no light sample of it exists, so the light page follows the app's own light fallback.
